states.observed: Focused affected tests passed locally (330 across the scope, marker, session, broadcast and contract files); ruff check and format clean.
states.accepted: Cases A, B and C passed on the fixture with two task changes, one worktree switch and an explicitly shared warning; a second independent fixture with shifted day and swapped projects passed in its own home.
states.externally_verified: CI run 37757138131 at f8b43265: mutation passed with every changed-line mutant killed (project_sessions 463, brain_writer_hook 120, 0 survivors), lint and smoke passed; the unit shards complete on the pull request.

measurements.note: The one unattributed event in A and C is the fixture marker written before any scope was in force; B counts the refused explicit claim.

reviews.standards: Closed after three rounds; seven findings fixed (hook safety, branch tracking, single scope read, naming).
reviews.spec: Three rounds; findings fixed with tests, the last (attributed outbox replays) fixed after round three. Open by ruling: live launch grants belong to SV2-IDN-04; the marker idempotency key trade-off is a ledger follow-up.

rollback_rehearsal.result: no transitions written; marker body equals the preceding lookup body; scope logs left in place

rollback: Set AGENTIHOOKS_SESSION_SCOPE=0 or revert the code; scope logs are authoritative history and are never rewritten to a default project.
limitations: Live hooks pass no launch grant until SV2-IDN-04; an explicit marker project_id is accepted as written until then.
Live hooks see task changes only across session starts; mid-session task changes and task_revision come from record_scope callers.
Codex transcript entries carry no branch; a new folder records an empty branch.
A session resumed before its last Stop ran leaves those earlier transcript entries unrecorded; their markers are unknown.
The marker idempotency key still omits the record time.
Scope logs have no retention sweep.
